name: GPU Vertex Shader Isosurface Extraction
definition: A technique to compute isosurfaces on GPUs by drawing a single quadrilateral for each tetrahedron and computing intersections in the vertex shader.
summary: GPU Vertex Shader Isosurface Extraction is a surface extraction method that maps marching tetrahedra topology to the vertex shader stage, offloading topological analysis and geometric interpolation to the GPU for efficient parallel processing.
